Looking for an alternative to Google Workspace for IT solutions that overcomes mail merge caps, fragmented add-ons, and AI usage limits?

Say goodbye to rigid quotas and tab-switching. Lark unifies secure messaging, docs, video meetings, no-code databases, and a single, high-speed workspace built for modern IT teams.

## Why look for alternatives to Google Workspace for IT

### Rigid automation quotas

Apps Script enforces a 6-minute execution limit and daily quotas, forcing Google Workspace Developers to build fragile workarounds for bulk operations.

### Mail merge bottlenecks

Google Workspace for Developers Mail Merge caps messages at 1,500 per day and requires Business Standard+, making high-volume outreach costly and constrained.

### Fragmented extension and AI

Google Workspace navigate two add-on frameworks while Google AI for Developers Uses Google Workspace features are gated behind costly expansion add-ons.

## Why Lark is the best Google Workspace replacement for IT

Escape Apps Script's 6-minute wall. Lark Base supports 1,000 to 500,000 automation runs per month for approvals, alerts, record updates, and HTTP-driven workflows.

## FAQs about Google Workspace replacements for IT

### What are the best free alternatives to Google Workspace for Developers?

While there are many cheap alternatives to Google Workspace, [Lark](https://www.larksuite.com/en_sg/) is an all-in-one workspace ideal for startups and growing developer teams. The Free plan supports up to 20 users and natively bundles unlimited chats with 18 months history, structured wikis, 100 GB storage, reliable video calls, and a flexible [no-code database](https://www.larksuite.com/en_us/product/base) to manage projects and workflows — plus access to 2,500+ developer APIs — without separate subscriptions.

### How do Google Workspace for Developers Mail Merge limits compare to alternatives?

Google Workspace for Developers Mail Merge caps Gmail multi-send at 1,500 messages per day per user and requires Business Standard or higher. Alternatives like [Lark](https://www.larksuite.com/en_sg/) use Base automation workflows to send personalized emails without this cap, while Zoho Workplace includes mail merge at lower plan tiers with higher sending limits.

### Can Google Workspace Extension Developers build on other platforms?

Yes. Google Workspace Extension Developers familiar with Apps Script and add-on frameworks can transition to Lark's 2,500+ open APIs, custom bot framework, and [AnyCross](https://www.larksuite.com/en_us/product/anycross) no-code integration platform. Microsoft 365 offers the Graph API and Power Platform, while Zoho provides a Developer Space with REST APIs and low-code tools.

### Is Google AI for Developers Uses Google Workspace cost-effective?

Google AI for Developers Uses Google Workspace features like Gemini are included at basic levels in Business Standard+, but advanced AI capabilities require AI Expanded Access or AI Ultra Access add-ons with strict daily/monthly usage limits. Many teams find that platforms bundling AI into core plans — such as Lark AnyGen — offer more predictable costs.

### Who are Google Workspace Developers' top competitors?

Google Workspace isn't the only player in the developer productivity space. The main competitors for Google Office Developers Workspace users include Lark, Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace, Nextcloud, and Notion. Each caters to different priorities around cost, privacy, extensibility, and integration depth.

### What is the best alternative to Google Workspace for IT among startups?

When it comes to Google Workspace for developers alternatives for startups, Lark often stands out as the top choice. This is because Lark offers a full suite of features essential for engineering workflows, plus a free plan supporting up to 20 users with full API access — making it ideal for startups looking to streamline productivity without breaking the budget.

### Will we lose our Gmail history and Drive files if we migrate?

Data migration complexity depends on your new platform. Most enterprise alternatives offer migration tools for Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Contacts. Lark provides dedicated migration support and expert guidance to ensure a secure, seamless transition of your historical data and user directory structure. [Contact Lark Sales](https://www.larksuite.com/en_us/global/salessupport)

### How do alternatives solve the Apps Script 6-minute execution limit?

A major complaint among Google Workspace Developers on community forums is Apps Script's 6-minute execution wall and daily quotas. Modern alternatives like Lark address this with AnyCross no-code integrations and server APIs that run as background workflows without script-level timeouts. Microsoft Power Automate offers longer timeouts on premium plans, while self-hosted platforms have no vendor-imposed limits.
